{{Top|leg}}
'''D-Quadrant''' was a quadrant of [[XX-9 heavy turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser turrets]] on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] gave the command for these turrets to cease fire on the fighters in the trench so that he could safely move in. It was destroyed in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] along with the rest of the Death Star during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Death Star">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
D-Quadrant first appeared in ''[[Death Star (novel)|Death Star]]'', a [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] [[List of books|novel]] written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]] and released on [[October 16]], [[2007]].<ref name="Death Star" />
